verdict.rationale: Semgrep AppSec Platform has a documented, OpenAPI-specified public API with a live playground and a formal deprecation policy. The documented scope is limited to listing deployments, gathering findings and listing projects, so parity with everything doable in the UI is not shown. The docs-path OpenAPI probe 404s are superseded by the spec published at semgrep.dev/api/v1. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for UI actions such as triage, rule and policy management, settings and onboarding; an explicit statement of API/UI parity; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Semgrep AppSec Platform provides an API that enables you to list deployments, gather findings created by Semgrep AppSec Platform, and list projects.
